evidence_quotes.agenda: not asked as a formal line -- the customer volunteered her reason for moving (a disruptive upstairs neighbor) unprompted
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: What is your, what is the person above you doing? / [extensive detail about nightly noise, months of complaints, unresponsive property manager] -- a real, unscripted second-layer follow-up question that drew out the full story
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if it only took two and a half or less than two and a half then you only pay $510 which is the minimum... I will make sure to bring the best team so it will make it as fast as possible so you pay less

top_strength: Genuine, unscripted empathy -- asked a real follow-up question about the noise problem and let the customer vent fully instead of rushing past it, then adjusted the arrival window to the afternoon without friction once she explained the leasing-office timing.
coaching_note: Never delivered Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, or Communication, and no rate-lock line at the close -- likely because the call leaned into the emotional conversation and skipped ahead to booking; worth practicing a way to circle back to the differentiators even on a high-empathy call.
grading_note: two_layers_deep scored 15 for a genuine, non-templated follow-up question -- this is not the no-concern-raised exception, it is real depth on an organically raised concern.
